title: Keep the best value seen so far
prompt: For each vector element, return the largest value seen up to that point. Return the same number of outputs as inputs. Empty input produces empty output. Inputs may be negative.

tests.label: Negative start
tests.hint: The first best value is the first input, not zero.

tests.label: Empty
tests.hint: Never access the first element of empty input.

tests.label: New high
tests.hint: Update best when you see a larger value.

hints: The last output element is the best so far.
An empty output means you have not seen any input yet.
explanation: The returned vector grows once per input value, preserving both order and count. It owns its storage independently of the input.
chapterTitle: Managing Dynamic Collections with Standard Containers
